dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Several prominent ring-shaped markings with light-colored perimeters and darker interiors are visible on the upper dorsal area; specifically, a clear 'O' shape is located mid-body with a sharp contrast gradient, and adjacent 'C' shaped arcs exhibit similar light-to-dark transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A cluster of high-intensity light-colored spots is concentrated near the base of the neck/shoulder area, appearing as localized, irregular blobs with minimal internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form an obtuse triangle, with the vertex at the highest dorsal point and two base points extending toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, linear orange-brown mark is visible on the upper surface of the tail fluke, contrasting with the surrounding dark grey tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: The texture pattern transition from dense, small light-colored spots on the neck to large, defined ring shapes on the mid-section is a highly unique visual feature.
